_readme: Sample .claude/contextus.json — copy to your project's .claude/ directory and edit. This is tier 3 (highest precedence): overrides plugin.json defaults and ~/.contextus/data/<project>/config.json. Only include keys you want to override.

providers._note: Shared connection settings. All features (embedding, expansion, calibration) reference these instead of duplicating endpoints.

ollama._endpoint_note: Ollama HTTP API. Change if running on a different port or remote host.

bedrock._region_note: AWS region for Bedrock InvokeModel. Uses default credential chain (env, ~/.aws/credentials, IAM role).

anthropic._note: Direct Anthropic API. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. No config needed here.

embedding._note: Vector embedding for semantic search. The provider that BUILT the corpus must match at query time — switching requires a full re-embed.
embedding._model_note: HuggingFace model ID (used by transformers provider). Both providers emit the same vectors.
embedding._ollamaModel_note: Ollama model tag. Must be pulled first: `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`
embedding._dimensions_note: Must match the model's output dimensions. nomic-embed-text = 768.
embedding._batchSize_note: Chunks per embedding batch. Higher = faster embed, more memory.

transformers._note: Only used when provider='transformers'. Ignored for ollama.
transformers._localModelPath_note: Pre-downloaded model dir (air-gapped installs). Empty = download on first use.
transformers._cacheDir_note: Override transformers.js cache dir. Empty = ~/.cache default.
transformers._remoteHost_note: Model download host. Point at internal mirror if HF is blocked.
transformers._allowRemoteModels_note: Set false for strict offline (fails if model not in cache/localModelPath).

retrieval._note: Controls what gets injected into Claude's context.
retrieval._topK_note: Max context files to inject per prompt (after dedup + floor).
retrieval._similarityThreshold_note: Post-ranking quality filter. NOT the injection gate — see injectionFloor.
retrieval._injectionFloor_note: Raw similarity gate: 'inject anything at all?' Calibrate per-project with /context-calibrate --floor.
retrieval._maxTokens_note: Token budget for injected context (approximate, pre-compression).
retrieval._provenanceFooter_note: Show 'Context: used: <file> (<score>)' footer. Set false to suppress.

expansion._note: Multi-vector query expansion: generates alternate phrasings when initial search scores poorly. Dramatically improves synonym/paraphrase recall.
expansion._mode_values: adaptive (expand when score < threshold) | always (every query, +100-200ms) | off (disable)
expansion._model_note: Model for primary provider. Ollama: small/fast recommended (qwen2.5:3b ~100ms). Bedrock: use full model ID.
expansion._fallback_note: Fires only on FAST failures (connection refused, DNS) with remaining time budget. Slow timeouts do NOT fall back.
expansion._expansionThreshold_note: Adaptive mode fires when best initial score < this. Range: 0.0-1.0. Lower = expand less often.
expansion._maxVariants_note: Alternative phrasings to generate (2-5 recommended). More = better recall, more latency.
expansion._temperature_note: LLM temperature (0.0-2.0). Higher = more diverse rephrasings.
expansion._timeoutMs_note: Total expansion time budget in ms. Shared between primary + fallback.

calibration._note: Quality evaluation: judges whether injected patterns were actually USED by Claude. Runs as a bounded campaign (N samples, then auto-disables).
calibration._targetSamples_note: Evaluations per campaign before auto-disable. Start with /context-calibrate --start.
calibration._model_note: Judge model. Haiku recommended (reliable, cheap). Ollama is the offline opt-in.

contextCapture._note: Pattern proposal system — how contextus suggests new patterns to capture.
contextCapture._mode_values: propose (suggest, user confirms) | auto (capture without asking) | silent (never suggest)

notifications._verbosity_values: silent (never) | normal (spawn/failure only) | verbose (also heartbeat with uptime)

logging._note: Daemon logging. All logs write to ~/.contextus/logs/.
logging._paranoid_note: Log full prompt text + complete injection payload to paranoid.jsonl. Privacy-sensitive. Good for debugging.

retention._activeDays_note: Days before standard logs rotate to archive/.
retention._archiveMonths_note: Months before archived .gz files are deleted.
retention._paranoidDays_note: Days before paranoid.jsonl is DELETED (not archived — privacy).
